162281.overview:
Escape is a 1-player adventure game for multiple systems.

You are stranded in a rather strange building. The elevator will take you to the first floor to escape, but first you need the correct "key". The player moves about a series of hallways from a 1st person perspective. There are numerous rooms, each of which contain a clue or a puzzle to help solve the password to use the elevator. In many of the rooms, the player can type in answers to questions. If the player ascertains the correct password to ride the elevator, they can escape to safety, otherwise they plummet to their death.

175958.overview: Empire is a strategy game inspired by the board game Risk where you must compete against the computer for world domination with nine skill levels. You are first presented with a map of the world with various white squares as well as some yellow neutral squares and you and the computer take it in turns to choose a white square as your territory. Once you have both chosen your territories you can then allocate an extra 26 armies with up to nine added to a territory. You and the computer now take it in turns to attack either the other players army or a neutral territory by selecting the territory they want to attack. Once the result is known and who ever wins the battle can then decide how many armies to place in the new territory. The game progresses until one player has captured all territories.

446486.overview: Eddie Steady Go! is a sequel to Back Track. After having escaped the labyrinths of Back Track, Eddie once again finds himself in trouble as he is recaptured by the mad professor. The professor has built a 22 part obstacle course which Eddie has to make his way through. The game consists of 22 single screen platform levels and the objective is simply to move Eddie from the left to the right side of the screen without being killed — very much like Hunchback. The controls are simple as all Eddie can do is move left, right and jump. The player has to watch out for arrows, rolling boulders, falling rocks and other objects that instantly kills Eddie when making contact. Eddie can also die by falling too far.

446487.overview:
Eight Ball is a 2-player billiards game.

Players take turns using their white ball to put striped or solid balls in the 6 pockets on the table. The player controls the direction of their shot by rotating their cue 360 degrees around the white ball. The power and spin on the ball can also be controlled.

446488.overview:
Electron is a 1 - 2 player clone of the arcade game Tron

Players compete in four different game grid scenarios:

Light Cycles: race a blue light cycle against one or more enemy cycles in an attempt to have them crash against their own light walls.
I/O Tower: blast through numerous grid bugs in an attempt to get into the I/O Tower.
MCP Cone: blast through the defensive walls of the MCP in order to get into its central cone.
Battle Tanks: maneuver a tank against one or more enemy tanks (or Recognizers) to be the last one standing.

446489.overview:
Everest is a managerial strategy game for the Dragon 32/64.

The player organizes a spring or autumn climbing expedition to summit Mount Everest, Lhotse, or Nuptse. At the beginning of the expedition the player must choose the amount of food, tents, oxygen, rope, and ladders to bring, with a total of 1800 lbs of space available. The player has a total of 6 climbers, and each day the player can move each climber to a higher or lower camp. This climber can carry a certain amount of resources, which are needed to keep the climbers healthy. The goal is to get enough resources to the highest camp in the minimal number of days to allow the hikers to summit the mountain. Hikers must have resources to avoid becoming injured during the climb. Random weather events and accidents can affect the climbers.

446563.overview:
In Eno, the player's eccentric aunt has just died and left the player her estate. She had millions. If the player finds it they can keep it. The only clue: living room. The player explores the rooms within his aunt's house looking for the treasure.

In Stalag, the player is alone in a Nazi prison camp, the year 1944. The Germans have moved all the other prisoners to a new camp as they know it is only a matter of hours until it is bombed by the Allies. They locked the gate and abandoned the camp, but the player was forgotten because they had been locked in the hot box. The player must escape the camp alive.
